resolved_contract.observation_rule: Only explicit visible owner-referenced qualitative observations with profile, context, provenance and visibility evidence participate. Raw member counts, titles, money, locations, wall-clock time and other unstated owner state do not imply dimension bands.
resolved_contract.resolution_rule: Visible observed evidence resolves only when one dimension-compatible band agrees under one profile/context tuple. Missing or explicit-unknown evidence remains unknown; incompatible-only evidence remains incompatible; divergent visible band/profile/context or observed/incompatible evidence remains conflict. Invalid dimension-band evidence is incompatible and canonical-owner contradictions are never auto-resolved.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Authorization filtering occurs before dimension state, counts, summaries, search, provenance, receipts and AI context; hidden cardinality remains undisclosed.
resolved_contract.growth_rule: Growth and pressure labels are descriptive only and never cause automatic failure, permission/action/command authority changes, canonical owner mutation or campaign-time advancement.
resolved_contract.persistence_decision: No durable ODL-02 persistence, duplicate owner ledger or migration 0022.
resolved_contract.production_scope: Read-only capacity/coordination/load projection contract plus accessible nonvisual panel only.
